name: Percent Clicker
description: Press any keybind (or combo like Ctrl+Alt+K) at chosen level percentages, in the game or as a real keyboard press (Discord mute/deafen), and re-press it when you die.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Master switch. When off, no rule will ever press a key.

toggle-keybind.name: Toggle Keybind
toggle-keybind.description: Turns the whole mod on/off while you are playing.

show-pause-button.name: Show Pause Menu Button
show-pause-button.description: Adds the Percent Clicker button to the pause menu. Rules are edited from there.

show-notifications.name: Show Toggle Notification
show-notifications.description: Shows a small notification when you toggle the mod with the keybind.

debug-log.name: Debug Log
debug-log.description: Logs every simulated key press to the Geode console.
